en: Remove unused or unconnected accounts with confirmation. Task history and local login folders are preserved; active operations and linked queued messages block removal.
Repair Windows taskbar identity and shortcuts, and isolate test windows from the desktop application.
The GitHub homepage now defaults to English, with a language link to the complete Simplified Chinese README.
zh: 新增账号移除与确认步骤，支持移除未登录账号，保留任务记录和本机登录目录；执行、账号操作或关联待发送消息尚未结束时阻止移除。
修复 Windows 任务栏应用标识和快捷方式，并将测试窗口与正式客户端隔离。
GitHub 首页默认显示英文，点击语言链接进入完整简体中文说明。
